issue.title: test_busy_cluster_compacts_narrow_and_restores_wide flakes in parallel check
issue.description: Proposed by phase sase-19f.6.1 note #1 while implementing queue multiplier projection. This ACE top-bar test failed in a full parallel just check lane and then passed serially and in a small -n 4 run on the unchanged tree. Investigate the failure under the wide lane, capture the assertion and load conditions, and fix the test or underlying timing behavior. No failure count beyond one fail/one rerun pass was recorded.

task_type_fields.evidence: Phase sase-19f.6.1 note #1: one failure during full parallel load, followed by serial and -n 4 passes on the unchanged tree; observed rate one failure in the recorded run, with no repeated sample.

evidence.note: Phase sase-1bd.1 note #4 independently saw test_busy_cluster_compacts_narrow_and_restores_wide fail in a two-file batch and pass in isolation on the unchanged tree; same timing flake as this task.

Flaked again in sase tool run cdcd017e9d742389d28d342dc6bf0c0d (sase-1dq landing, scoped lane 522 files, 4 workers, 6095 passed / 2 failed); passes in isolation on the same tree with and without the landing diff (next-word widgets only, no top-bar code).

Proposed by sase-1dr.12 (note #13, sase-1dr.12--2, 2026-10-01): rebased-tree sase tool run check 5365ee94e85f547588de3684a4d779d1 failed test_busy_cluster_compacts_narrow_and_restores_wide, which passed on an isolated rerun of the same tree; the memory-history launch diff does not touch the ACE busy-cluster layout.

sase-1ez.4 (idle-gc-policy) note #1: during the just check escalation to the full suite (51810 passed), this node failed and triage classified it KNOWN, witness 9d2cc9514de3b284d26268fc5af548c8, verdict no_new_failures. The same timing flake under parallel load; nothing in the GC-policy phase files touches the top bar.
